refnamediv.refpurpose: Function to create an object to simulate dice rolls

refsynopsisdiv.programlisting: SilikoFunction *SilikoOperationDiceCreate( unsigned long long int seed);

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoOperationDiceCreate function makes a new SilikoFunction object using an implementation of a 64-bit Meesenne Twister, seeded by seed, to generate dice roll results. This object is used by Siliko Core to implement its d operator.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: A pointer to the newly created SilikoFunction object if successful, NULL if there was an error. This object can be used to call the dice operator logic directly, or installed into a SilikoEngine object.
